COUNT CAVEAT: the positive rests on a service operated under Russian Federation law in an area whose jurisdiction is disputed; if the project decides not to record such services, change to UNRESOLVED and count 0. Project decision 6: recorded as the claim of one party; jurisdiction disputed.
unresolved_issue: COUNT DEPENDENCY (not resolved here): the positive rests on a service operated by FSUE Rosmorport under Russian Federation instruments in waters whose jurisdiction is disputed by Ukraine; Project_Decisions_2026-09-30 contains no decision on whether such services are recorded or counted.
